jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Trucking
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


Waabi's Commercial Product team defines and delivers the end-to-end commercial product that makes autonomous trucking deployable, scalable, and valuable to customers. We sit between autonomy, operations, business development, and customers, turning driverless capability into a real-world product that can be launched, sold, operated, and scaled.
As Waabi rapidly scales from commercial pilots to large-scale driverless deployments, this role serves as the critical integration layer between truck supply, customer commitments, expansion efforts, site activations, and autonomy capabilities. You will manage the execution of the commercial plan, proactively tracking dependencies and mitigating risks to drive clear commercial progress.
We are hiring a Senior Program Manager to own and align the single integrated commercialization plan, ensuring every element converges seamlessly.
While functional program leads manage their respective areas, you will integrate their milestones into the overarching commercial plan. Success relies on sound judgment: identifying critical dependencies, distinguishing real timeline slips, and resolving decision bottlenecks. A year from now, when leadership asks whether we are on track for a launch, a truck delivery or a customer commitment, the answer should be one page, current, and believed by every team on it.
What You'll Do
You will own the integrated commercialization roadmap for trucking and the weekly operating cadence around it. This includes:
Build and own the integrated roadmap that ties customer commitments, OEM truck supply, autonomy and ODD readiness, lane and site activation, Mission Control, operations readiness and Account Management launches to dates, with the dependencies between them made explicit. You own the plan end to end.
Maintain the honest picture: the critical path, the slips, the risks and the decisions needed, surfaced early enough to act on and framed for the people who have to decide.
Lead the execution of key company milestones involving multiple departments at Waabi.
Run the operating cadence, including a weekly cross-functional Truck Program meeting.
Help establish repeatable frameworks, procedures, and decision loops that allow fast and efficient scale.
Produce executive-ready updates and program artifacts.
Communicate clearly with technical, operational, commercial and executive audiences that value first-principles thinking.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means the commercial plan converges on purpose rather than by heroics. Specifically, you will have:
Within 90 days, one integrated roadmap that Autonomy, Operations, Sales and Account Management believe, with the Truck Program meeting running off it.
A first driverless launch with no dependency discovered in the final month that was knowable in the first.
Leadership learning about a slip from you, with options, before they learn about it from a customer.
Decisions with a date, an owner and a record, so the same question is not re-decided in three meetings.
Qualifications Required
7+ years in program or product leadership in a complex technical and operational environment (autonomous vehicles, automotive, aerospace, robotics, aviation, defense, logistics or other physical-world deployment).
Track record of integrating programs across teams you did not control, in a business with hardware, software, safety and operations in the loop.
Enough technical fluency to understand why an autonomy or hardware milestone slipped and whether the recovery plan is credible, without needing to be the engineer.
Separates facts, assumptions and risks in how you write and speak; comfortable telling senior people something they do not want to hear, early, with options.
Builds the minimum structure that works and removes or upgrades it when it stops working.
Executive-grade verbal and written communication; most of this role's influence happens in documents and in how a problem is framed.
Set direction for a program others execute, with no direct reports, and being accountable for the outcome anyway.
Strongly Preferred
Ownership mentality: takes initiative and gets into the trenches with key stakeholders.
Varies the degree of detail to the audience and the moment.
Experience running a weekly holistic program review.
Experience taking a physical product from pilot to commercial deployment, where readiness gates and launch dates were real.
Experience working alongside a safety or systems-engineering function on go/no-go decisions.
Experience with OEM or supplier delivery schedules as a dependency in a commercial plan.
Zero-to-one program experience at an early-stage or scaling company.
Nice to have
Direct experience in autonomous trucking, freight or AV commercialization.
Experience working with operations and/or commercial teams.

jobs.title: Staff Vehicle Program Manager
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


Waabi is adding OEM partners, and each partnership needs an engineer who owns the technical integration from program setup to on-road milestones. The Vehicle Program Manager is Waabi's technical face to one OEM partner. They turn company goals into an integrated program plan, align Hardware, Embedded, Onboard, Infra and Autonomy to deliver it, and make sure integration milestones land on schedule. A successful candidate can span the range of executive meetings to in vehicle debugging on the test track. As we scale to more partners, each OEM needs its own dedicated owner, for focus and for partner confidentiality. We are looking for an engineer with breadth across the autonomous capable systems, the ability to go deep, and a curious, startup mindset that speeds up our autonomous vehicle programs.
 
You will...
Own the technical integration of the Waabi Driver with an OEM partner, from program setup through driverless operation.
Be part of a team of multidisciplinary Engineers and Research Scientists using an AI-first approach to enable safe self-driving at scale.
Turn company goals into an integrated program plan with the partner, covering Waabi and OEM deliverables, cross-team dependencies and the critical path.
Balance resources and priorities across Hardware, Embedded, Onboard, Infra and Autonomy, and make trade-off calls when one plan affects another.
Act as Waabi's technical face to the OEM and build trust at every level, from executive reviews to working-level engineering teams.
Go deep when it matters: work with engineers on test vehicles to triage integration issues and drive them to a decision.
Spot risk before it reaches the schedule, bring options with a recommendation, and escalate early and clearly.
Hold Waabi's technical standards with the partner, adapting to how each OEM works and pushing back credibly when needed.
Develop and maintain program reporting for Waabi leadership and partner executive forums
 
Qualifications:
8+ years of engineering experience in vehicle development, autonomous vehicles, ADAS or robotics, including 3+ years leading technical integration programs.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical, Electrical, Computer or Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
Breadth across actuation and autonomy system integration (sensors, compute, embedded, and software) and the judgment to weigh trade-offs between them.
Ability to rapidly go deep on a technical issue with engineers, work it to a decision, and return to the program view.
Solid problem solving using dependency mapping, critical-path analysis and risk management, with clear options for leadership.
Strong written and verbal communication, equally effective in an OEM executive review and a test-vehicle debug session.
Comfort with ambiguity and a startup pace: filters signal from noise and adds structure without adding overhead.
Open-minded and collaborative team player with the willingness to help others.
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions.
 
Bonus/nice to have:
Solid understanding of how vehicle OEMs plan, gate, validate and decide, including vehicle programs, DVP&R, V&V and supplier management.
Experience with commercial truck or heavy-duty vehicle platforms.
Hands-on experience with test vehicles, vehicle networks such as CAN, and field issue triage.
Experience with program tools such as Jira, and with AI tools that reduce manual tracking.
Technical experience in developing self-driving vehicles.

jobs.title: Senior Compensation Manager
jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


About the role

Waabi continues to scale its breakthrough technology into commercial deployment, and how we attract, reward, and retain exceptional people will be central to the ongoing growth and innovation. This role directly shapes that story: understanding where the business is going and ensuring our compensation structure continues to support that trajectory. You'll be responsible for designing for the current and the future while also being the trusted expert for employees, managers, executives, and company leadership when it comes to our compensation approach and program.
 
You will...
Anchor compensation in the business trajectory. Build a deep understanding of Waabi's growth path, including headcount plans, commercialization milestones, geographic expansion, and funding outlook, and use it to guide compensation decisions.
Design the compensation structure of the future and the plan to get there. Define how base, equity, and variable pay work together to support where the business is headed. Understand today’s structure, set the long-term philosophy, ranges, and grant guidelines, then lay out the roadmap and sequencing to evolve if needed.
Own the end-to-end annual compensation cycle, including administering the compensation tool and partnering with managers and senior leaders to plan outcomes for their teams. Streamline and scale the process, including through AI tools where they add value.
Lead market benchmarking for all roles across Waabi's locations, deeply understanding the job architecture and talent marketplace, to effectively complete job matching, survey submissions, and recommending updates to cash and equity ranges.
Build bottoms-up compensation forecasts with Finance, modeling spend and equity usage against the business plan. Own a variety of modeling and analysis projects to inform decision making.
Lead compensation enablement and education across the organization. Be the single owner of how Waabi teaches compensation: 
Training managers on the structure, philosophy and how pay decisions are made
Helping employees understand the value and mechanics of their total compensation, including stock options
Equipping Recruiting to structure competitive offers
Building employee communications that tie it together
Communicate and advise across company leadership. Translate complex compensation topics into clear recommendations and trade-offs for the executive team. Manage preparation of compensation materials for board review and discussions
Ensure pay equity and compliance through regular reviews and adherence to pay transparency and reporting requirements across the U.S. and Canada.
Qualifications:
A bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
7+ years of compensation experience, ideally in high-growth technology companies, including owning annual cycles and multi-location benchmarking.
Experience designing compensation philosophy, structures and programs (salary, variable and equity).
Extensive analytical and modeling skills (including building forecasts) as well as expertise in benchmarking and survey methodology (Radford, Carta, Pave, etc).
Executive presence, with clear, confident communication to employees, managers, and senior executives.
Strong collaboration and communication skills
Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive, confidential information.
Enthusiasm for applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to improve workflows.
Open-minded and collaborative team player with the willingness to help others.
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions.
Bonus/nice to have:
Experience with private company compensation planning, including planning through company evolution (revenue, funding, and maturity).
Experience managing preparation for board review of compensation programs.
Direct experience in HIgh-Tech, AI or AV company, with an understanding of how the talent marketplace shapes pay.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to automate compensation analysis, modeling, or cycle workflows.

jobs.description:

With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. We are looking for an Associate to join as an early member of our FP&A team. In this role, you will act as a force multiplier for the finance organization, bringing analytical rigor and strategic clarity to our most critical workstreams. This is a high-visibility opportunity for an impactful contributor to have a front-row seat to the growth of a frontier tech leader and help architect our long-term financial foundations.
 
 
You will:
Establish Foundational FP&A: Build and manage the core frameworks for a scaling organization, including leadership reporting, monthly budget vs. actuals analysis, and cross-functional financial discipline.
Manage the Full Year Budget and Forecast: Support budget preparation and oversight, involving the development of annual operating budgets, forecasts, and financial plans. Regularly collaborate with leadership, working together to monitor and adjust budgets as needed to protect cash flow.
Reporting and Tracking Financial Performance: Produce accurate and timely financial reports as well as collaborating on the development of board materials. 
Create dashboards to monitor daily/monthly financial performance against goals, identifying trends, variances, and risks to support data-driven decision making.
Establish processes and methodologies to track and report on KPI’s.
Continuous System Improvement: Identify, lead, and execute opportunities to improve, automate, standardize financial systems and reporting processes to optimize efficiency.
Provide End-to-End Modeling Support: Build and maintain the sophisticated financial models that underpin our strategic and commercial initiatives—ensuring every decision is grounded in rigorous data.
Financial Analysis: Conduct in-depth financial analysis to support decision-making. Evaluate investment opportunities, pricing strategies, and cost-saving initiatives.
 
About You (Qualifications):
Professional Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in Investment Banking/Private Equity and FP&A/Strategic Finance role at a high-growth technology company.
Analytical Rigor: Advanced financial modeling skills with a focus on accuracy and scalability. You take pride in the quality of your work and can translate complex data into reliable decision-making tools.
Agency & Execution: A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity. You are highly organized, capable of managing multiple workstreams, and proactive in moving projects to completion with minimal oversight.
Executive Communication: The ability to distill vast amounts of data into clear, concise, and polished insights for executive audiences.
Financial Management: Comprehensive understanding of financial management, analysis, tools and reporting methodologies. Including experience with selecting and/or implementing FP&A software tools..
Systems Mindset: A natural inclination to build frameworks from scratch and a desire to make financial processes more efficient as the organization grows.
